items.title: Show HN: I told people I'm a convicted felon after 20 years of hiding it (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Hi there. I was engineer number 3 at Eventbrite and founding engineer at Reforge. I've created a dozen or so startups myself and have worked in many others, like Instacart. All this time, no one knew that I was a convicted felon. It wasn't exactly a topic that came up, but it was certainly something that I never brought up. When you're a convicted felon, people look at you as if you are tainted. I was unable to rent apartments in San Francisco. I was unable to get a job directly after being released from prison. It's funny because when you owe the state $17,000 in restitution and you can't get a job, people become extremely desperate. And that desperation can easily put you right back into prison. So I went from homeless person at age 19 to 7-figures about 10 years later. I retired at age 38. What I'm doing now is writing an autobiography. The main theme of it is hope. And I want to make sure that people know about it. They don't necessarily have to be interested in it, but if people know about what it's like sleeping in a car believing that one day you will travel the world and then actually doing it, then I think I've accomplished my task in writing this book. If you're interested, please let me know. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50182960 Points: 2 # Comments: 0

items.title: Show HN: Datachef - full-stack data platform (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Hi HN, I'm Joe. I'm a data engineer, and I built Datachef because I got tired of maintaining the disjointed data stack (Fivetran, Airbyte, Airflow, Snowflake, Redshift, S3, dbt, Looker, Tableau, a reverse-ETL tool, etc.) and being a middleman for business users that just wanted to self serve. Datachef is one managed platform where you can: - Connect your business systems (Salesforce, Marketo, Hubspot, etc.) and/or databases (Postgres, MySQL) in a few clicks. Your data lake is synced in minutes. - Explore your data via natural language or write SQL directly. - Model how data is combined, filtered and aggregated. Create a shared system of intelligence. - Share models across the org so every query, report and slide deck tells the same story. - Integrate data back into Salesforce, Marketo and HubSpot - lead scores, segments and events, in the systems your team already works in. We shipped a Claude connector (https://www.datachef.com/blog/datachef-claude-connector). From Claude you can run complex, multi-step/multi-dataset analysis, and create or update your models and sync settings. I'd love feedback, especially from anyone who has run the modern data stack and has opinions on what consolidating it should and shouldn't give up. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50182888 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

items.title: Open-source, cross-harness memory for AI agents trending on X (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Earlier this year, my co-founder and I found ourselves frequently switching between different coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) anytime we ran out of shaky usage limits or a newer, better model came out. We became increasingly frustrated with having to re-explain our tasks, workflows, common mistake patterns, etc. anytime we switched agents. We found no good free alternatives out there, so we built our own and fully open-sourced it! Beacon hooks into 20+ different agent harnesses, captures session telemetry (prompts, tool calls, command executions, etc) in one normalized format, and distills it into common patterns and repeatable workflows with a human-approval step. This compounded knowledge is then accessible to any future agent via skills / MCP. We believe your agent data is yours to own and should not be locked behind any frontier lab's ecosystem or closed memory infrastructure. We built Beacon to make working across agents way more transparent and efficient. Try it out and tell us what you think: https://github.com/Asymptote-Labs/agent-beacon Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50182883 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
